name: Todoist
author: Jacob Vincent-Mink
description: Adds bounded overdue, upcoming, assigned, and recently completed task context from Todoist.

categories.label: Overdue
categories.description: Active tasks whose due date has passed.

categories.label: Today and upcoming
categories.description: Active tasks due today or within the next seven days.

categories.label: Assigned to me
categories.description: Active tasks returned by Todoist's assigned-to-me filter.

categories.label: Completed activity
categories.description: Tasks completed during the requested digest window.

setup.summary: Uses a Todoist API token for read-only task queries. OmaDigest stores the token as a secret.

fields.label: API token
fields.description: Copy your personal API token from Todoist Settings → Integrations → Developer.
